Author: Sudhir Agarwal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 34
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 1876 of 1998
Revisionist :- Rishi Pal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- P.C.Srivastava

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 6.10.1998 passed by Ist Addl. Sessions Judge, Muzaffarnagar in Criminal Appeal No.
6/96 rejecting the appeal of the revisionist and upholding the convection and sentence passed by the trial court dated 31.1.96 under Section 16 (1) (a) (i) read with Section 7 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
